Package gui

Class BookingController

java.lang.Object
gui.BookingController
public class BookingController extends Object
controller for the booking form screen (BookingFrame.fxml).

lets a logged-in visitor or guide request a new park visit. handles park loading, time-slot setup, order-type selection, client-side validation, live price estimation, waiting-list offer dialog, and navigation to the confirmation screen.

validation rules mirror the server so the user gets fast feedback before the round-trip.

    • suppressAvailabilityCheck

      private boolean suppressAvailabilityCheck
      when true, the date/time change listeners skip the background availability check. set while the form is being populated programmatically (e.g. applying an alternative slot) so the availability round-trip does not run concurrently with a BOOK_ORDER request — the two would race on the shared awaitResponse flag in ChatClient and clobber each other's results.

    • updateAvailability

      private void updateAvailability()
      queries the server for free slots once park, date, and time are all chosen, then shows "Available spots: X of Y" in green, or a full-slot notice in orange. stays blank until the visitor has picked all three fields.

      runs the network call on a short-lived daemon thread so the JavaFX Application Thread is never blocked. an AtomicBoolean guard skips the request if a previous one is still in-flight (prevents concurrent ChatClient calls).

    • updateVisitorHint

      private void updateVisitorHint(String orderType)
      locks or unlocks the visitor-count field and updates the hint based on visit type. SOLO is fixed at 1; FAMILY allows 2-15 for anyone; GROUP is for registered guides (2-16).
      Parameters:
      orderType - the currently selected visit type string

    • updatePriceEstimate

      private void updatePriceEstimate()
      recomputes the price estimate live. clears the label if inputs are incomplete. SOLO: 1 × fullPrice × 0.85 (15% pre-booked discount). FAMILY: visitors × fullPrice × 0.85 (15% family discount). GROUP: (visitors − 1) × fullPrice × 0.75 × 0.88 (guide free + 25% group + 12% advance).

    • handleSubmit

      public void handleSubmit(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      validates the form, sends BOOK_ORDER, then either navigates to the confirmation screen or offers a waiting-list dialog when the park is full.
      Parameters:
      event - the button-click event

    • buildAndValidate

      private logic.BookingRequest buildAndValidate()
      validates all form inputs and builds a BookingRequest on success. SOLO = exactly 1 visitor, any role. FAMILY = 2-15 visitors, any role. GROUP = 2-16 total, registered guides only (guide enters free at check-in).
      Returns:
      a populated BookingRequest, or null if validation failed

    • offerWaitingList

      private void offerWaitingList(logic.BookingRequest req)
      offers to join the waiting list or book an alternative slot when the park is full.

      fetches up to 3 nearby available slots from the server (same-day different time, then next-day same time). if alternatives exist a third "Book Alternative" button is shown alongside "Join Waiting List" and "Cancel". choosing "Book Alternative" opens a choice dialog so the visitor can pick a slot, then immediately re-submits the booking for that slot without leaving the form.

      Parameters:
      req - the original booking request, reused for waiting-list entry or as a template for alternative bookings

    • showConfirmation

      private void showConfirmation(logic.BookingResult result)
      pushes a simulated notification to NotificationCenter, then navigates to the confirmation screen. a day-before reminder is also added automatically when the booked visit falls tomorrow.
      Parameters:
      result - the booking or waiting-list confirmation from the server
